text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This evening's destination appears to be
a place
quite special to Light Hello.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
It's a bit of a trek, but I promise you'll
love it! I
can't wait to see your
reaction! ♪

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Ta-da! We've made it!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Beautiful, isn't it? You can see the stars
so clearly
from here! And no one's
around! It's almost like a
private beach!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! ♪ And you know, I actually grew
up near
here.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
This really brings me back... I used to
practice
running on this very beach all
the time.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
After finally collapsing late in the
evening after a
long session, I would
always be looking toward
the sky...
waiting to wish upon a shooting star.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"I wish I could get into Tracen Academy
and
become a G1 winner, just like
Mother..."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
When part of that wish finally came true
and I
received news of my acceptance, I
was so, so
happy.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Even though leaving my friends behind
was
painful, I was encouraged to do my
best as they
saw me on my way.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
And well... I never ended up being able
to enter a
G1 race.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
But I'll never forget the kindness of my
trainer
and upperclassmen. And you
know... If it wasn't
for all of that, I never
would have met you, either.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...O-oh. Oh dear.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry! Please forget what I just said!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Ah, really? Well, thank you for listening.
choice_data_list: いえ、すごく嬉しいです

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps deep down, I knew that I
wanted you to
hear this story some time
or another...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just then, I notice a flash of light out of
the
corner of my eye.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Oh look, a shooting star!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Okay, good! I was able to repeat my
wish three
times. This one should come
true as well.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! ♪ That's going to have to stay a
secret for
now. At least until I can tell
you without any
reservations.
choice_data_list: 今度はどんなお願いを？
choice_data_list_en: What kind of favor do you need this time?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
And until that day comes, let's continue
to do our
best on the reboot plan!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Nothing will prepare us for more hard
work like
some tasty eats!

Table for two!
Wait, Light Hello? Is that
you?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember me? We used to be in
the same
class!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Oh my, it's been ages, hasn't it? I'm
amazed
that you actually remembered
me!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Of course I do! Been reminded of you a
lot these
days, you know? See that
poster over there?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Yes, I am indeed overseeing
production of
that event.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
I saw it in the newspaper too! Please
know that
I'm cheering you on!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
It looks like part of my wish is already
coming
true. I never thought I'd gather
this much support
at all...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Hehe, indeed!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
The day that I can finally reveal my wish
to you
might not be so far off after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Drip... drip...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Ah, what was that? Don't tell me...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Eek! That was a raindrop, wasn't it! Let's
get out
of here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We rush towards the trees to seek
refuge from the
sudden downpour. All
we can do is wait for the
rain to
subside...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Achoo!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Urgh... I'm all soaked... And cold.

Oh? Is that you, Hello? If you were
going to visit,
you should have called!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: M-mom?!

text_block_list.name: Hello's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Hi there! May I ask what you two are
doing all the
way out here? It looks like
you're practically
frozen to the bone!

text_block_list.name: Hello's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I suppose you were caught in that
sudden
downpour? Why don't you come
over to the
house now so you can at
least borrow some
jackets!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I-it's fine! I'll figure something out. You
really
shouldn't be treating me like a
child anymore.

text_block_list.name: Hello's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh hush now, no need for any of that.
Stay a bit
longer and I'll make your
favorite carrot sauce
spaghetti!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: R-really?

text_block_list.name: Hello's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, come along now before you
catch a
cold.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Um... Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we take Light Hello's mother up
on her
invitation and rest up at her
childhood home.
